title: NASA-UAP-D026, Apollo 14 Debriefing, 1971
what_is_it: An audio recording (with metadata) of a post-mission astronaut debriefing.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extractable from this document (likely audio/scanned with poor OCR); all fields are derived from war.gov catalogue metadata, not from the recording's contents.
The 'light flash phenomena' is a documented biological effect (cosmic-ray-induced retinal flashes), not evidence of a UAP, despite this file's inclusion in a UAP-labelled collection.
Facts here cannot be independently verified against the recording itself without the audio transcript.
